description: This Java class 'DefaultTbDeviceProfileService' implements device profile management functions such as save, delete, and set default device profile within the Thingsboard platform, extending an abstract service and utilizing various dependencies for data handling and logging.

classes.name: DefaultTbDeviceProfileService
classes.description: Service class for managing device profiles, including saving, deleting, and setting default profiles, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a device profile, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a device profile, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: setDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Sets a device profile as default, updates previous default if necessary, logs actions, and handles exceptions.
